video.title: Morgan Stanley Inclusive & Sustainable Ventures | Airpals

description: Meet Airpals, a recent participant of Morgan Stanley Inclusive & Sustainable Ventures. Airpals is using generative AI to streamline corporate shipping by automating administrative workflows, cutting costly errors and giving enterprises full visibility across carriers and locations.
